result.reviewScopeSummary: Read the Story 3 spec, full tech design, and test plan; inspected the lower-band compression/provider/runtime wiring and supporting tests; audited the production path for fake or missing execution seams; ran the real provider-backed suite directly, forced the missing-auth failure path, and ran both `npm run verify` and `npm run verify-all`.

newFindings.title: Real chunk-close maintenance never wires the lower-band scheduler into production
newFindings.evidence: `updateChunkState` only schedules compression when `options.lowerBandCompressionScheduler` is present (`src/thread/async-thread/services/chunk-service.ts:671-680`). The real async maintenance path calls `updateChunkState` with only `{ store, now }` and no scheduler (`src/thread/async-thread/services/async-thread-run-service.ts:1100-1107`). A repo-wide inspection found no runtime instantiation of `LowerBandCompressionService` or `PiCodexLowerBandCompressionProvider` outside their definitions, while the passing close-path test injects `lowerBandCompressionScheduler: service` directly in the test harness (`tests/thread/lower-band-compression-service.test.ts:337-355`). As shipped, closed chunks will not auto-produce detailed/brief semantic artifacts in the real app path even though the gate is green.

newFindings.title: Required manual calibration evidence is missing from the story artifacts
newFindings.evidence: The story requires manual calibration evidence: 'Representative conversation-only Chunk transcripts have been manually reviewed with generated detailed and brief outputs' (`docs/spec-build/epics/05-real-lower-band-compression/stories/03-gpt-oauth-lower-band-compression.md:44-45`). I found only validate/implementor/progress artifacts under `docs/spec-build/epics/05-real-lower-band-compression/artifacts/03-gpt-oauth-lower-band-compression/`, and `.context-steward/debug/lower-band-compression.log` contains completion metadata but no captured reviewed transcript/output examples or review notes.

productionPathFindings: Closed-chunk semantic compression is not wired into the real async maintenance path: only test code passes a `lowerBandCompressionScheduler`, so the runtime app path will not auto-generate detailed/brief lower-band artifacts on chunk close.
additionalObservations: The new provider/service path is real when invoked: `tests/thread/lower-band-compression-provider-backed.test.ts` passed directly, and a targeted rerun with an empty auth store failed loudly with `OpenAI Codex OAuth credential is not configured for provider openai-codex.`, which is good evidence for TC-6.3a.

`npm run verify` passed with 474 non-E2E tests, and `npm run verify-all` passed after rerunning `verify` plus the E2E lane; the gate green status is therefore not enough on its own to establish Story 3 readiness because the production close-path scheduler wiring is still missing.

The default non-E2E gate really does include the provider-backed suite: `package.json` maps `test` to `node scripts/run-node-tests.mjs service`, and `scripts/run-node-tests.mjs` includes every `*.test.ts` except `.e2e.test.ts`, so `tests/thread/lower-band-compression-provider-backed.test.ts` is part of `npm run verify`.
